title: Reconcile two accounts without inventing consensus
goal: Separate shared facts, real contradictions and unmentioned details.
explanation: Two sources can differ because they cover different times or quote different people, not because one is necessarily false. Preserve attribution and compare like with like. Agreement is not proof of truth when sources may repeat the same origin. The fictional source pair includes a deliberate time distinction.
sampleInput: Source A, 09:00: “The repair event has 30 registrations. Organizers plan two tables. The venue is the East Hall.” Source B, 17:00: “Registrations reached 42 after lunch. Organizers confirmed East Hall and said a third table may be added.”
prompt: Create three sections: shared supported facts; differences with source/time attribution; unresolved questions. Distinguish a later update from a contradiction and a proposal from confirmation. Quote the relevant words. Do not average counts or invent a final decision.
workedExample: Shared: East Hall. Updated count: 30 at 09:00 versus 42 by 17:00, not necessarily a conflict. Two planned tables versus a possible third is an unresolved plan, not confirmation that three exist.

steps.title: Annotate each source
steps.text: Mark timestamp, confirmed facts, plans and tentative language independently.

steps.title: Run the synthesis
steps.text: Require source labels and quotes for every comparison.

steps.title: Check alleged conflicts
steps.text: Ask whether each difference concerns the same time, definition and scope.

steps.title: Investigate dependence
steps.text: Note that the texts may share an organizer as their original source; do not call them independent verification.

steps.title: Draft a cautious update
steps.text: State the most recent attributed facts and one question that needs confirmation.

checks: The count change is identified as a time update rather than an automatic contradiction.
Every comparison has source/time attribution and no invented average or consensus.
commonMistakes: Counting two articles that repeat one press release as two independent confirmations.
offline: Use a two-column evidence ledger and write the shared/different/unresolved sections by hand.
reflection: Which apparent contradiction disappeared once you compared timestamps?

evidence.title: Keep the build
evidence.detail: Save your original input, exact prompt and resulting artifact. The count change is identified as a time update rather than an automatic contradiction.

evidence.title: Show what you tested
evidence.detail: Record a pass/fail result and evidence for every check below. The third table remains tentative.

evidence.title: Explain a limitation
evidence.detail: Write what changed after one deliberate revision and name a remaining failure mode. Treating omission as disagreement.
